gloss: unexpectedly; suddenly; out of the blue

definitions.gloss: unexpectedly; suddenly; out of the blue
definitions.explanation: Describes something that happens without warning or preparation, catching someone off guard.

examples.japanese: {不意|ふい}に{名前|なまえ}を{呼|よ}ばれた。
examples.english: My name was called out of the blue.

examples.japanese: {不意|ふい}に{昔|むかし}のことを{思|おも}い{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I suddenly remembered something from the past.

examples.japanese: {散歩|さんぽ}{中|ちゅう}に{不意|ふい}に{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{出|だ}して、{傘|かさ}もなく{濡|ぬ}れてしまった。
examples.english: During my walk it suddenly started raining, and without an umbrella I got soaked.

notes:
USAGE:
The base form {不意|ふい} is also used in the expression {不意|ふい}を{突|つ}く (to catch off guard, to take by surprise). {不意|ふい}に as an adverb describes unexpected events that happen to the speaker.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不意|ふい}に{現|あらわ}れる (to appear suddenly)
- {不意|ふい}を{突|つ}く (to catch off guard)
- {不意|ふい}の{来客|らいきゃく} (an unexpected visitor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {突然|とつぜん} is more emphatic and dramatic
- {急|きゅう}に emphasizes speed
- {不意|ふい}に emphasizes the element of surprise
